wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.description: The prepaid balance your vehicles fuel from. Top it up by bank transfer.
wallet.lowBalanceHint: It is below the company's alert threshold of {{threshold}}. Top up so vehicles keep fueling.
wallet.statementHint: Every movement of the wallet, newest first, with the balance after it.
wallet.noEntriesHint: Movements appear here once a top-up is confirmed.
wallet.creditHint: For a transfer you have checked on the bank statement. It waits for a manager's approval before the wallet is credited. A bank reference can be recorded only once.
wallet.credited: Transfer recorded, waiting for a manager's approval
wallet.refundsHint: Fuelings Operations reversed: the amount went back to your wallet.
wallet.noRefundsHint: A refund appears here when Operations reverses a fueling.

topUps.title: Top-up requests
topUps.description: Bank transfers reported by companies. One person verifies each against the bank statement; a manager approves it before the wallet is credited.
topUps.minesHint: Operations checks each transfer against the bank statement before crediting the wallet.
topUps.bankReferenceHint: Exactly as it appears on the transfer receipt.
topUps.requestHint: Send the transfer first, then report it here. Operations credits the wallet after checking the bank statement.
topUps.cancelHint: Operations will not credit it. You can report the transfer again later.
topUps.correctedReferenceHint: Only if it differs from the one the company reported.
topUps.rejectHint: The company sees your reason. Nothing is credited.
topUps.emptyHint: Requests appear here when a company reports a bank transfer.
topUps.emptyMineHint: Report a bank transfer to top up the wallet.
topUps.verifyHint: Check the bank statement and enter what actually arrived. Nothing is credited yet: a manager approves it next.
topUps.receivedAmountHint: From the bank statement, not the company's figure. This is what will be credited.
topUps.amountsDifferHint: The verified amount, not the company's figure, will be credited. Check the statement before approving.
topUps.evidenceReferenceHint: Where the proof is: a statement line, a scan number or an e-mail subject.
topUps.approveHint: The verified amount is credited to the wallet at once and this cannot be undone here.
topUps.needsManager: An Operations Manager or Super Admin approves this.
topUps.ownVerification: You verified this one: a different manager must approve it.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Each night every wallet balance is checked against the ledger. The ledger is the truth; any difference is listed here.

kind.PAYABLE_MISMATCH: Station payable differs from the ledger

reconciliation.emptyHint: The first nightly check runs at 02:30 Cairo time, or run one now.
reconciliation.superAdminOnly: Only a Super Admin can start a check by hand.

pending.title: Not connected to live data yet
pending.B3: This screen shows wallet balances and top-ups, which arrive with the wallet and ledger.
pending.B4: This screen shows fuelings, alerts and their totals, which arrive with the fueling engine.
pending.B5: This screen shows device sync, which arrives with offline sync.
pending.B6: This screen shows station settlements, requests and the audit view, which arrive with station finance.

common.reasonHint: Kept in the audit log with your name.
common.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it.
common.secretOnceHint: Write it down or copy it now. It can't be shown again; a new one can only replace it.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Fleet companies on ZAWED. Open one to manage its departments, vehicles and tags.
companies.search: Search by name or tax ID
companies.emptyHint: Onboard the first fleet company to start.
companies.noResultsHint: Try another name or clear the filter.

companyForm.lowBalanceHint: The company is alerted when its wallet falls below this.
companyForm.cooldownHint: From 120 to 240 minutes. 180 if left empty.

company.freezeHint: A frozen company's vehicles can't fuel until it is unfrozen.
company.frozenBannerHint: Its vehicles can't fuel until Operations unfreezes it.
company.policyHint: Only a Super Admin can change these, with a reason kept in the audit log.
company.budgetHint: For monitoring only; a budget never blocks a fueling.
company.noVehiclesHint: Add the company's first vehicle, then issue its RFID tag.

vehicleForm.plateHint: Exactly as registered. Spaces and Arabic or Western digits are all fine.
vehicleForm.vipCeilingHint: Raises a flag for Operations when passed. It never blocks a fueling and the company never sees it.
vehicleForm.fleetCodeHint: The company's own number for the vehicle. It must be unique within the company.

vehicle.suspendHint: A suspended vehicle can't fuel until it is reactivated.
vehicle.reactivateHint: The vehicle can fuel again with its active tag.
vehicle.decommissionHint: Final. Its tags are deactivated, its limits retired and its plate freed for another vehicle.
vehicle.decommissionedBannerHint: It is kept for history and can't change.
vehicle.issueTagHint: Scan the tag or type its UID: 8 to 32 hexadecimal characters. Spaces and colons are fine.
vehicle.noTagsHint: Issue a tag so this vehicle can fuel.
vehicle.tagFinalHint: Final: this tag can never be used again, on this vehicle or any other.
vehicle.tagReplacementHint: The tag stops working now. Issuing the new tag closes this one and keeps the vehicle's cooldown.
vehicle.tagReactivateHint: Cancels the replacement: the tag works again.
vehicle.limitHint: Replaces the current limit for the same kind and period.
vehicle.removeLimitHint: The vehicle will no longer be limited for this kind and period.
vehicle.noLimitsHint: Without limits, only the cooldown and the wallet stop a fueling.

stations.title: Stations
stations.description: The station network and the operators who run it. Open one to manage its devices and agents.
stations.emptyHint: Add the first station of an operator to start.
stations.noResultsHint: Try another name or clear the filter.

stationForm.invalidCoordinate: Enter a decimal number from -{{max}} to {{max}}.
stationForm.connectivityHint: Low means the station often loses its connection, so its devices sync less often.

station.closedBannerHint: It is kept for history and can no longer change.
station.suspendedBannerHint: Its devices can not fuel vehicles until it is reactivated.
station.suspendHint: A suspended station can not fuel vehicles until it is reactivated.
station.reactivateHint: The station can fuel vehicles again.
station.closeHint: Final. A closed station can never be reopened or changed. Its history stays.

operators.title: Operators
operators.search: Search by name or tax ID
operators.emptyHint: Register the first station operator to start.
operators.noResultsHint: Try another name or clear the filter.

operator.suspendedBannerHint: Its stations can not fuel vehicles until Operations reactivates it.
operator.suspendHint: None of this operator’s stations can fuel vehicles until it is reactivated.
operator.reactivateHint: Its stations can fuel vehicles again.

devices.title: POS devices
devices.registerHint: The device gets a code that is shown on the POS. The activation code is shown once, after you register it.
devices.label: Label
devices.labelHint: For example "Pump 3". Helps your team tell devices apart.
devices.activationHint: Enter this code on the device to activate it. It expires if not used in time.
devices.emptyHint: Register the POS device this station will use.
devices.newCodeConfirm: Create a new activation code for device {{code}}?
devices.revokeHint: Final. The device stops working now and can not be activated again. Register a new device instead.
devices.pageDescription: Every POS device on the network. Open a station to register or revoke its devices.
devices.pageEmptyHint: Devices appear here once they are registered on a station.

agents.title: Agents
agents.addHint: The agent gets a worker ID and a PIN. The PIN is shown once, and the agent must change it at first sign-in.
agents.pinHint: Give the worker ID and this PIN to the agent. They choose their own PIN at first sign-in.
agents.mustChangePin: Has not set their own PIN yet
agents.emptyHint: Add the people who fuel vehicles at this station.
agents.resetPinHint: The old PIN stops working and the agent must choose a new one at next sign-in.
agents.resetPinConfirm: Create a new PIN for worker {{workerId}}?
agents.suspendHint: A suspended agent can not sign in until reactivated.
agents.reactivateHint: The agent can sign in again.
agents.deactivateHint: Final. The agent can never sign in again. Their history stays.

prices.title: Fuel prices
prices.description: The price per litre every station charges. A price is never edited: schedule a new one instead.
prices.scheduleHint: A price is never edited and never starts in the past. Leave the start empty to start now.
prices.invalidPrice: Enter a price above zero, with up to two decimals.
prices.startHint: Cairo time on your device. Empty means now.
prices.invalidStart: Enter a valid date and time.
prices.noneNowHint: Schedule the first national price for each fuel.
prices.emptyHint: Scheduled and past prices appear here.

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.description: Your company’s vehicles. To change one, send a request to ZAWED.
vehicles.noResultsHint: Try another plate or clear the filter.
vehicles.emptyHint: ZAWED adds your vehicles when your company is onboarded.

vehicle.noTagsHint: This vehicle can fuel once ZAWED issues its RFID tag.

network.title: Network
network.description: Your stations, their POS devices and agents. Changes go through ZAWED Operations.
network.noStationsHint: Stations appear here once Operations adds them.
network.noDevicesHint: Devices appear here once Operations registers them.
network.noAgentsHint: Agents appear here once Operations adds them.

users.title: Users
users.description: The people who sign in to ZAWED, their roles and the organisations they belong to.
users.emptyHint: Users appear here once a Super Admin creates them.
users.noResultsHint: Try another name, role or status.
users.resetPasswordHint: The old password stops working, every session ends and the user must choose a new password at next sign-in.
users.resetPasswordConfirm: Create a new temporary password for {{email}}?
users.suspendHint: A suspended user can not sign in until reactivated. Their sessions end now.
users.reactivateHint: The user can sign in again.
users.deactivateHint: Final. The user can never sign in again. Their history stays.
users.resetMfaHint: Their authenticator is removed and every session ends. They set it up again at next sign-in.

userForm.title: New user
userForm.hint: The user gets a temporary password, shown once, and must change it at first sign-in.
userForm.mustChange: Must be changed at first sign-in
userForm.mustChangeHint: Give the e-mail and this temporary password to the user. They choose their own password the first time they sign in.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every sensitive change, newest first: who did it, to what, and when.
audit.emptyHint: Entries appear here as people use the platform.
audit.forbidden: Only a Super Admin can read the audit log
audit.forbiddenHint: Ask a Super Admin if you need to know who changed something.

fuelings.title: Fuelings
fuelings.opsDescription: Every fueling on the platform, newest first, including the ones that were declined.
fuelings.companyDescription: Your company's fuelings at ZAWED stations, newest first, including declined attempts.
fuelings.stationDescription: Fuelings at your stations, newest first, including declined attempts.
fuelings.notBilledHint: A VIP vehicle: the fueling is recorded but nothing is charged to the wallet.

declineHint.COOLDOWN: The tag fueled recently and cannot fuel again until its cooldown ends.
declineHint.TAG_INACTIVE: The tag is lost, stolen, deactivated or waiting for a replacement.
declineHint.VEHICLE_INACTIVE: The vehicle is suspended or decommissioned.
declineHint.FUEL_TYPE_MISMATCH: The fuel requested is not the vehicle's fuel type.
declineHint.FUEL_NOT_AVAILABLE: The station has no price for this fuel.
declineHint.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The fueling would pass one of the vehicle's limits.
declineHint.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: The company's wallet could not cover the amount.

fuelings.emptyHint: Fuelings appear here as soon as a pump records one.
fuelings.noResultsHint: Change the status or the dates to see more.
fuelings.conflictsTitle: Recorded offline with checks the terminal could not make

conflict.FUEL_NOT_AVAILABLE: Fuel not sold at the station
conflict.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Wallet short: the rest is owed by the company
conflict.STALE_CAPTURE: Sent more than 7 days after the fueling
conflict.AGENT_UNVERIFIED: Agent's session on this terminal could not be confirmed
conflict.DEVICE_CLOCK_SKEW: Terminal clock was ahead; judged when it arrived
conflict.STATION_NOT_ACTIVE: Station was not open: payable held

conflict.OVER_OFFLINE_ALLOWANCE: Terminal spent more offline than allowed: payable held

fuelings.exportFailed: The export could not be prepared. Try a shorter range.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.opsDescription: Hard alerts raised by fuelings and wallets. Acknowledge one once someone has looked into it.
alerts.companyDescription: Alerts about your company's fuelings and wallet.

type.COMPANY_OFFLINE_EXPOSURE: Company offline spending over the limit

explain.TANK_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: A fueling was larger than the vehicle's tank.
explain.VIP_CEILING_PASSED: A VIP vehicle passed its monthly ceiling.
explain.LOW_BALANCE: The wallet fell below its low-balance threshold.
explain.SYNC_CONFLICT: A fueling captured offline broke a rule the terminal could not check. It is recorded; review it.
explain.SYNC_REJECTED: A terminal sent a fueling the server could not record (for example an unknown tag). Fuel was dispensed: follow it up with the station.

explain.OUTCOME_MISMATCH: The server completed a fueling whose answer the terminal never received, and the agent was told it was refused. Check with the station and the company.
explain.COMPANY_OFFLINE_EXPOSURE: Terminals together recorded more offline spending for one company than its wallet can cover. The fuelings are recorded; review them and the company's balance.

summary.VIP_CEILING_PASSED: {{plate}} reached {{month}} this month, over its ceiling of {{ceiling}}.
summary.LOW_BALANCE: The balance is {{balance}}, below the threshold of {{threshold}}.

alerts.emptyHint: Nothing needs attention with these filters.

sync.title: Terminal sync
sync.description: When each active terminal last reached the server, what its last batch did, and what it still holds.
sync.emptyHint: Terminals appear here once they are activated.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.opsDescription: What happened each day across the platform. Choose a day to see its fuelings.
calendar.companyDescription: What happened each day in your fleet. Choose a day to see its fuelings.
calendar.stationDescription: What happened each day at your stations. Choose a day to see its fuelings.

finance.title: Finance
finance.balanceHint: What the platform owes the station
finance.bankNoneHint: Payouts need a verified account. Request one from the bank's letter.
finance.pendingChange: A bank account change is waiting for approval
finance.pendingChangeHint: {{bank}}, account ending in {{last4}}. A second person in Operations must approve it.
finance.statementHint: Every movement of what the station is owed, newest first, with the balance after it.
finance.noEntriesHint: Movements appear here once fuelings are charged.

bankChange.title: Request a bank account change
bankChange.hint: Enter the account from the bank's letter. The number is stored once and is never shown again, only its last four characters. Another person must approve it, and payouts pause for a while afterwards.
bankChange.holderNameHint: As written on the bank's letter.
bankChange.letterHint: The reference of the letter that confirms the account.
bankChange.done: Bank account change sent for approval

payout.title: Record a payout
payout.hint: Record a bank transfer made to the station's verified account. A large payout waits for a second person before it posts.
payout.doneApproval: Payout recorded. It waits for a second person to approve.

settlements.title: Settlements
settlements.description: Money going out to stations and refunds going back to companies. A second person approves each one.

payouts.emptyHint: Record a payout from a station's page.
payouts.approveHint: Approving posts the payout and lowers what the station is owed. You can't approve a payout you recorded.
payouts.cancelHint: The payout is dropped and nothing is posted. The reason is kept in the audit log.

bankChanges.emptyHint: A change appears when someone requests a new account for a station.
bankChanges.approveHint: Check the bank's letter first. Once approved, payouts go to this account, but pause for a while as a safety measure. You can't approve your own request.
bankChanges.rejectHint: The current account stays in use. The reason is kept in the audit log.

holds.emptyHint: An offline fueling the terminal could not fully check is held until Operations releases it.
holds.releaseHint: The station can be paid for this fueling. State what you checked; it is kept in the audit log.

reversals.emptyHint: Request a reversal from a fueling's page.
reversals.requestHint: The company is refunded and the station's payable is taken back, once a second person approves.
reversals.approveHint: The amount returns to the company's wallet and leaves the station's payable. You can't approve your own request.
reversals.rejectHint: The fueling stays as it is. The reason is kept in the audit log.

stationSettlements.title: Settlements
stationSettlements.description: What the platform owes your stations, where it pays, and what was paid.
stationSettlements.noStationsHint: Stations appear here once Operations adds them.
stationSettlements.noPayoutsHint: A payout appears here once Operations records the transfer.
stationSettlements.reversalsHint: Fuelings Operations reversed. Their amount was taken back from what the station is owed.
stationSettlements.noReversalsHint: Reversals appear here when Operations approves one.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.opsDescription: When each pump agent signed in on a terminal. A row opens the fuelings of those days.
shifts.stationDescription: When each of your pump agents signed in on a terminal. A row opens the fuelings of those days.
shifts.emptyHint: A shift starts when an agent signs in on a terminal.

tickets.title: Tickets
tickets.companyDescription: Ask Operations for help, for example a lost tag or a changed limit, and follow the answer here.
tickets.stationDescription: Report a terminal fault, ask about a payout or a price, and follow the answer here.
tickets.opsDescription: What companies and stations asked for. Take a ticket, answer it, then resolve it.
tickets.companyEmptyHint: Open a ticket when you need Operations to do something.
tickets.stationEmptyHint: Open a ticket when you need Operations to look at something.
tickets.opsEmptyHint: Tickets from companies and stations appear here.
tickets.noResultsHint: Change the status or type to see more.
tickets.subject: Subject
tickets.newHint: Operations answers here. You will see the reply in the ticket.
tickets.closedHint: Open a new ticket if you need more help.

adjustments.requestHint: A credit with no bank transfer behind it. A manager must approve it, and the wallet is credited only then.
adjustments.reasonHint: Why the wallet is credited. Kept in the audit log with your name.
adjustments.approveHint: The amount is credited to the wallet at once and this cannot be undone here.
adjustments.rejectHint: The requester sees your reason. Nothing is credited.
adjustments.cancelHint: Nothing will be credited. You can ask again later.
adjustments.emptyHint: Requests appear here when someone asks to credit a wallet without a bank transfer.
adjustments.ownRequest: You requested this one: a different manager must decide it. You can withdraw it.
adjustments.needsManager: Waiting for an Operations Manager or Super Admin.

onboarding.title: Ready to fuel?
onboarding.hint: Required steps must be done before the vehicles can fuel.

import.description: Add many vehicles at once from a CSV or Excel file. The file is checked first and nothing is added until you confirm.
import.templateHint: Fill in one row per vehicle. The column headings can be in Arabic or English.
import.fileHint: CSV or XLSX, up to 5 MB.
import.pastEmptyHint: Imports for this company appear here.
import.sameFileTitle: This exact file was imported before
import.sameFileHint: Importing it again will find its vehicles already registered. Check that it is the file you meant.

rowErrors.INVALID_TANK_CAPACITY: Must be more than 0 and at most 1,500 litres
rowErrors.UNKNOWN_DEPARTMENT: Not a department of this company

import.nothingHint: No row is valid. Fix the file and upload it again.

import.validOnly: Import only the valid rows ({{valid}}) and skip the others
import.cancelledHint: Nothing was added. Upload the file again to start over.
import.doneHint: Vehicles were added to the company. Rows that failed or were skipped were not added.
import.existingHint: Registered by someone else while the import ran.
import.skippedHint: Rows with problems, left out of this import.
